subject: Vendor onboarding & PO path — follow-up and stakeholder map
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finedge.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@finedge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO path — follow-up and stakeholder map

Hi Laura / Tom — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared checklist and next steps.

Call highlights (short):
- Pilot ask: 30-day pilot for fraud-detection prompts across payments ingestion, scoped to 200K tokens/day.
- Primary economic buyer: Diana Park (CFO) — Laura confirmed budget owner is Diana, will need a short finance sign-off.
- Security/legal: they require SOC 2 Type II and a short security annex completed by Redwood; legal expects to review the annex and run a standard redline.
- Procurement/PO: FinEdge requires vendor onboarding (vendor form + W9 equivalent), then a PO to be issued to pay monthly usage. Typical internal PO window Laura suggested is 2–3 weeks once the vendor packet is submitted.

Proposed immediate next steps (would like to confirm):
1) I’ll share a draft SOW and a one-page pro-forma invoice for PO routing (attached: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx).
2) We’ll send our SOC 2 summary and the small security annex for your legal to review (I’m attaching a short security annex stub; will send PDF).
3) Please connect procurement contact(s) so we can get the vendor packet and any internal supplier ID info.
4) Schedule a 30–45 minute PO/process sync with procurement + finance + our AE/CS to confirm timeline and approvals — proposing Thu 8/27 or Fri 8/28.

Open Qs for you:
- Any specific invoice remit instructions or PO numbering format we should use?
- Do you need a supplier questionnaire filled out before the PO starts? If yes, can procurement share the form?

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx (draft SOW), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (link in email thread)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate on the SOW and security annex once we confirm procurement contact.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai
(attachment: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finedge.com>

Thanks Hannah — great summary. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Procurement lead is Angela Ruiz (angela.ruiz@finedge.com) — I’ve CC'd our procurement alias below for next steps.
- We do have a vendor packet (vendor_form_v3.xlsx) that procurement needs completed and uploaded to our vendor portal. I’ll ask Angela to share it directly.
- For invoicing: we use PO numbers formatted FIN-YYYY-####; please put 'Payable to Redwood Inference, EIN: 12-3456789' on the pro-forma to help finance route quickly.
- Timeline: if we receive the completed vendor packet + SOW this week, procurement can usually issue a PO within ~2 weeks. If Diana approves budget this week, we can fast-track.

Looping in procurement: FinEdge Procurement <procurement@finedge.com>. Angela — Hannah will send the SOW + vendor info; can you confirm the vendor packet and any additional docs you need?

On the security side: legal will want the security annex and SOC2 summary. We typically do a short 1–2 week legal review for standard annexes.

Best,
Laura
Head of Product Operations
FinEdge
